article_context: 文章介绍研究发现：与陌生人交谈往往会改善情绪与归属感，而人们之所以回避，常是误以为陌生人不愿交流。

article.title: 翻译 · 陌生人的短暂交流也能提升归属感
article.background: 文章介绍研究发现：与陌生人交谈往往会改善情绪与归属感，而人们之所以回避，常是误以为陌生人不愿交流。

sentences.en: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection, laughter, and warmth.
sentences.zh: 我们往往认为，朋友和家人是我们获得联结、欢笑与温暖的最大来源。

segments.text: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection, laughter, and warmth.

sentences.en: While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn't expect.
sentences.zh: 这很可能确实如此，但研究人员最近还发现，与陌生人互动实际上会带来我们未曾预料的情绪改善和归属感提升。

segments.text: While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn't expect.

sentences.en: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
sentences.zh: 在一系列研究中，研究人员让芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者主动与身边的人交谈。

segments.text: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.

sentences.en: On average, participants who followed this instruction felt better than those who had been told to stand or sit in silence.
sentences.zh: 平均而言，照做的参与者比那些被要求默默站着或坐着的人感觉更好。

segments.text: On average, participants who followed this instruction felt better than those who had been told to stand or sit in silence.

sentences.en: The researchers also argued that when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers, it is often due to a misplaced anxiety that they might not want to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 研究人员还认为，我们之所以回避与陌生人的随意交流，往往源于一种错位的焦虑：担心对方不愿和我们说话。

segments.text: The researchers also argued that when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers, it is often due to a misplaced anxiety that they might not want to talk to us.

sentences.en: Much of the time, however, this belief is false.
sentences.zh: 然而很多时候，这种想法并不正确。

segments.text: Much of the time, however, this belief is false.

sentences.en: As it turns out, many people are actually perfectly willing to talk—and may even be flattered to receive your attention.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，许多人其实非常愿意交谈，甚至可能因为得到你的关注而感到受宠若惊。

segments.text: As it turns out, many people are actually perfectly willing to talk—and may even be flattered to receive your attention.
